content:
root = Stack([title, graph, note])
title = CardHeader("Auth DB Failure Propagation", "Dependency direction: service depends on dependency; auth-db failure propagates through dependents")
graph = GraphViewer("What fails when auth-db goes down?", nodes, edges, legend, "auth-db", "RIGHT")
note = Callout("warning", "Failure order", "auth-db fails first, followed by auth-service. Then session-cache and api-gateway fail; checkout, search, and admin-console follow. Finally, payments and fraud-check are not affected by auth-db through this dependency graph, while notifications and reporting fail after their upstream services.", true)
nodes = [{id: "auth-db", label: "auth-db", kind: "root"}, {id: "auth-service", label: "auth-service", kind: "affected"}, {id: "session-cache", label: "session-cache", kind: "affected"}, {id: "api-gateway", label: "api-gateway", kind: "affected"}, {id: "checkout", label: "checkout", kind: "affected"}, {id: "payments", label: "payments", kind: "unaffected"}, {id: "fraud-check", label: "fraud-check", kind: "unaffected"}, {id: "search", label: "search", kind: "affected"}, {id: "search-index", label: "search-index", kind: "unaffected"}, {id: "admin-console", label: "admin-console", kind: "affected"}, {id: "notifications", label: "notifications", kind: "affected"}, {id: "reporting", label: "reporting", kind: "affected"}]
edges = [{source: "auth-service", target: "auth-db", label: "depends on"}, {source: "session-cache", target: "auth-service", label: "depends on"}, {source: "api-gateway", target: "auth-service", label: "depends on"}, {source: "api-gateway", target: "session-cache", label: "depends on"}, {source: "checkout", target: "api-gateway", label: "depends on"}, {source: "checkout", target: "payments", label: "depends on"}, {source: "payments", target: "fraud-check", label: "depends on"}, {source: "search", target: "api-gateway", label: "depends on"}, {source: "search", target: "search-index", label: "depends on"}, {source: "admin-console", target: "auth-service", label: "depends on"}, {source: "notifications", target: "checkout", label: "depends on"}, {source: "reporting", target: "admin-console", label: "depends on"}]
legend = [{kind: "root", label: "Initial failure", explain: "The failed dependency"}, {kind: "affected", label: "Fails transitively", explain: "Depends directly or indirectly on auth-db"}, {kind: "unaffected", label: "Unaffected by auth-db", explain: "No dependency path from auth-db"}]
